arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
# Values in millions
march_2009 = 6833543
september_2009 = 7551862

# Arc percent change calculation
difference = abs(september_2009 - march_2009)
average = (march_2009 + september_2009) / 2

arc_percent_change = (difference / average) * 100

print(f"March 2009: {march_2009}")
print(f"September 2009: {september_2009}")
print(f"Difference: {difference}")
print(f"Average: {average}")
print(f"Arc percent change: {arc_percent_change}")
print(f"Rounded to 3 decimal places: {round(arc_percent_change, 3)}")
EOF
